name: Proving Grounds - moves, anchors, then fires with AOE
notes: Mario's sixth requested design. The crawler marches until three troopers are within its range 6, then attack.windupTicks holds its first shot for 30 ticks - spent only while it is genuinely in firing position, never while marching - before attack.splash (the detonation {radius,damage} shape, reused as an attack) lands on the whole cluster at once instead of one trooper at a time. Watch the gap in the headless log between the last move.intended and the first attack.launched: that gap is the windup, not the travel time.
